text:
Ana M: Quick heads-up — agenda for today's slate-review: prioritize 3 incoming model brings (MistralX-8B, FalconLite-13B, Community-30B), sync on quant experiments, and flag any eval regressions. Please drop blockers and owners.

Mike L: +1. I've got perf numbers from the smoke runs for MistralX-8B (baseline fp16) and early 8-bit quant. Sharing highlights later.

Sophia R: one ask — can we include the summarization regression tests in the checklist? saw a small drop on long-docs with the community-30b fp16 run.

Kevin P: noted. I'll add the summarization evals to the bring-up checklist. Also need to know which test prompts are stable vs flaky.

Lia Z: owner suggestions: I'll take FalconLite-13B quant path; Mike can lead MistralX-8B analysis; Sophia can pick up community-30B quality triage?

Ana M: sounds good. Lia — can you drive 8-bit and QAT experiments for FalconLite? estimate a quick matrix: {batching, kv-cache warm, activation memory}.

Lia Z: yes. tentative plan: run 8-bit (GPTQ-style) and Sym8 quant, test with batch sizes [1,4,8], and measure latency p50/p95. schedule: start tomorrow, ETA initial numbers by EOD+2.

Dev Bot: New intake ticket created: https://boards/redwood/INTAKE-7432 — please add owners.

Mike L: sharing quick perf snippet from MistralX smoke (fp16):
```
model: mistralx-8b
seq_len: 1024
batch: 4
latency_p50: 22ms
latency_p95: 58ms
throughput: 45 tok/s per GPU
```
planning same config for 8-bit to compare.

Sophia R: community-30b regression: rouge-l down ~3pts on long-docs set. small sample but consistent across 3 seeds. Suspect tokenization edge-case + sampling temp.

Nora Q: QA note — regression triage checklist: 1) replicate on older eval harness, 2) verify tokenization artifacts, 3) compare deterministic sampling vs current config, 4) run failure-case full decode logs. I'll run step 1-2 today.

Kevin P: For prioritization scoring, propose we use: impact (0-5), cost (0-5, lower better), risk (0-5), infra readiness (0-5). Weighted score = 0.4*impact - 0.3*cost - 0.2*risk + 0.1*infra. Quick votes?

Ana M: agree. Quick scores: MistralX-8B impact 4, cost 2, risk 2, infra 4 => weighted ~ (1.6 -0.6 -0.4 +0.4)=1.0. FalconLite-13B impact 3, cost 3, risk 3, infra 3 => ~0.0. Community-30B impact 5, cost 4, risk 4, infra 2 => ~(2.0 -1.2 -0.8 +0.2)=0.2. So order MistralX, Community, FalconLite but re-run after QA results.

Mike L: MistralX looks highest to me; plus it's low cost and good perf. I'll attach detailed perf logs to INTAKE-7432.

Lia Z: tiny request — does Dedicated infra need different quant knobs? e.g., some kernels differ on A100 vs H100.

Kevin P: yes. Note in the checklist: record hardware type, CUDA/cuDNN versions, and kernel flags. Also add a fallback policy if quant causes model divergence (auto-roll back to fp16).

Sophia R: for community-30b, I'll pair with Nora to run the full decode logs and share a minimal repro. If it's tokenizer-related we can patch tokenizer first.

Nora Q: will do. Also can add a small regression dashboard row in Redwood Console for these three models so PMs can see trends.

Ana M: action items: Mike -> attach perf logs (INTAKE-7432); Lia -> start FalconLite quant matrix; Sophia/Nora -> community-30b regression triage; Kevin -> add infra/hardware checklist and fallback policy to the intake doc. We'll reconvene Friday 10am PT for results.

Mike L: acked.

Lia Z: ack.

Sophia R: ack, adding notes to the intake ticket.

Kevin P: I'll update the checklist now.

Dev Bot: Reminder scheduled: Friday 10:00 PT — #eng-ml meeting (slate-review follow-up).

Ana M: thanks all — if any blocker pops up ping me and add a short note in the ticket. :thumbsup:
